title: Commodity Trading Intelligence
thesis: Snowflake streams MDEX price feeds in real-time, forecasts CPO prices with ML, detects position risk anomalies, and answers trading queries in natural language — all native SQL, no external quant platform needed

talking_points: RM 2.8 billion monthly trading volume across CPO futures and physical contracts.
Five thousand open positions. Three margin calls triggered this month — all on the back-month spreads.
CPO trading at $42/tonne premium over spot — highest in 6 months.
show: Point at the RM 2.8B volume KPI
tabs.call_out: 3 margin calls this month — position risk elevated

transition.line: Let's drill into which desks are driving the risk.

talking_points: ML.FORECAST predicts CPO front-month settling at RM 4,280/tonne — 3.2% above current.
Basis risk widening: physical-MDEX spread at RM 85 vs RM 60 historical average.
Soybean oil ratio at 1.12x — palm oil relatively cheap, potential upside.
show: Show CPO price chart with ML forecast band
Point at the basis risk widening
tabs.call_out: ML forecasts 3.2% upside — basis risk is the concern

transition.line: The price is moving. Let's see how our positions are exposed.

talking_points: Five thousand positions, RM 340M total margin deployed. Three positions above 85% margin utilization.
ML.ANOMALY_DETECTION flags Desk-3 back-month spread as anomalous — 2.4 standard deviations from normal.
Hedge effectiveness at 92% — within policy but declining from 97% last month.
show: Show position risk heatmap by desk and contract month
tabs.call_out: Desk-3 anomalous — 2.4 sigma, approaching margin call

transition.line: Now let the Head of Trading ask the system directly.

talking_points: Encik Rizal asks: 'Which positions are at risk of margin call this week?'
Cortex Analyst writes the query, returns: 3 positions across Desk-3, total exposure RM 47M.
Follow-up: 'What do the latest broker reports say about Q1 CPO outlook?' — agent searches market reports.
show: Type: 'Which positions are approaching margin call?'
Switch to advisory mode for market intelligence
tabs.call_out: Two AI modes: trading analytics + market intelligence

talking_points: Seven Snowflake capabilities, six AWS services.
In Snowflake-only mode — Snowpipe Streaming replaces Kinesis, ML.FORECAST replaces custom quant models.
Malaysia sets the global CPO price via MDEX. RM 120B annual palm oil derivatives volume.
tabs.call_out: One platform, native SQL, real-time trading intelligence

transition.line: That's Snowflake and AWS — better together for commodity trading.
